deploy-bot: deploy v3.8.1 -> prod(us-west) finished. kicking postdeploy smoke: prefill, kv-warmup, synth-chat. watch 20m.

sam_ops: initial prefill sweep flagged 3/15 mismatched seeds on host edge-07 only. payloads returned 200, small token diffs. no latency increase.

leo_ml: can you paste one diff? could be tokenization or rounding.

sam_ops: diff: baseline: "…model outputs this." new: "…model outputs this.." (extra period token)

nina_oncall: extra punctuation could be nondeterministic quant. Is host on different GPU batch?

sam_ops: edge-07 running heterogeneous bin (mixed q8 and q4). others in that pool are q4-only.

infra-bot: probe-job 9102 started target=edge-07 tests=[prefill,kv-warmup] by sam_ops

leo_ml: recommendation: pin traffic for edge-07 to previous model v3.8.0 for safety, and run targeted warmup to repopulate kv cache.

nina_oncall: agree. apply pin and rerun warmup. escalate if regression >1% after 10m.

deploy-bot: routing change: pinned service:inference-edge-07 -> model v3.8.0 (rule id: pin-2026-1766).

sam_ops: ran `/infra warmup edge-07 --concurrency=3` -> re-probe shows 15/15 matching.

leo_ml: looks resolved. leave pin in place for remainder of watch (10m) while we investigate mixed-quant path. will file follow-up with artifact team.

nina_oncall: no global rollback. watch continues. notify #eng-ml if anything regresses.

deploy-bot: postdeploy summary: edge-07 pinned -> v3.8.0, warmup retried, probes green. watch expires at 1765460120.
